items: Tap a done exercise to see its details: start and end time, calories per minute, how it compares to your usual for that activity, records (like your longest ride in 90 days) and how many you've done today and this week
Weight sessions also show the Workout Buddy sets you did during that workout, total reps and pounds moved, and any new bests (needs the sheet script update)

When your watch sends a workout that was already planned (like a bike ride), the planned one is hidden right away so it doesn't count twice, with a note under Exercise saying what it replaced. With two rides planned, the watch ride replaces the one closest in length
Fixed: when Josh and Michelle started a watch workout in the same minute, only one of them came through. Michelle's 8:20 ride from today has been added
Michelle: the Copy Health Auto Export URL button is back in Settings > Apple Watch, for setting up automatic watch workouts
The ✉️ button now sits beside the title on the Plan, Settings and Wizard screens
New ✉️ button in the top-right corner of every screen: it holds all your dietitian's notes, even after you tap Got it. A red number shows how many are new
Fixed: a dietitian note could vanish from Today when you came back to the app; it now stays until you tap Got it
New 🪄 Wizard tab: tap the wand and it builds a day from foods you've actually eaten in the last 6 months, aiming for your calorie budget and macro goals
Untick any target (calories, protein, carbs, fat or fiber) to let the wand ignore it. "Close enough" sets how near counts as a hit (±50 cal and ±10 g to start)
📌 keeps a food when you wand again; ✕ removes it; tap a food to see a few swaps that keep your totals close, or other amounts you've had
+ Add puts your own foods, saved meals or exercise into the plan, and Pull in day brings in a day's food and exercise for the wand to fill around
Turn off "No additional exercise" and, when food alone can't hit your targets, the wand may suggest one of your usual workouts (for example +45 min bike ride)

Apply adds the plan as planned food and exercise on that day, or on chosen weekdays for up to 4 weeks. Meals that already have food are left alone unless you choose Replace, and food you've eaten is never touched
Save plan keeps a day under a name (like "High-protein weekday") to load again later, and your dietitian can mix your saved plans into the days it plans for you
Fixed: picking servings (or any unit other than the food's own) when adding a food saved it in grams instead, so 2 servings showed as 2 g. Michelle's almonds and hot dog bun from today are corrected
The target date box on the Progress card no longer runs past the edge on the iPad
Removed the Health Auto Export link button from Settings (the watch is set up)

New Macro goals card on the Plan tab: set daily grams for protein, carbs, fat and fiber. Today's banner shows your progress on each: protein and fiber turn green once you reach them, carbs and fat turn red if you go over
Today's banner now shows Protein, Carbs, Fat and Fiber. Tap one to see its grams next to each food and each meal; foods missing that number show an orange dash. Tap again to hide
Search results show "Your foods" first, then a blue USDA box for foods you haven't added yet
Adding food is steadier on the phone: the search box no longer jumps while you type, and autocorrect is off in it
The add-food screen drops the meal buttons and just says which meal you're adding to
Quick entry asks whether you're sure of the calories or your dietitian can adjust them
Searching your foods also shows matches from the USDA food database; tap one to add it to your foods
Quick entries are saved to your foods, so next time you can just search and tap them
New switch in Settings > Extras: show today's progress against your original target, with exercise as extra on top
Barcode scanning is much better: sharper camera, a stronger reader and a box to aim at
New "Take a photo instead" button when a barcode won't scan live
Notes from your dietitian now show at the top of today, with Got it and Reply (older notes under 📬 Coach notes)
Swipe left on a food in your log to delete it (with Undo)
Food list shows the restaurant and when you last had each food
Restaurant foods with a known serving open at 1 serving instead of grams
A meal you've already saved shows "Saved as …" instead of asking again
Fixed: a food opened in servings showed the wrong calories until you changed the amount
Settings has a new Apple Watch card: the link for Health Auto Export, and the last watch workout received
What's new: this list, opened from the bottom of Settings, with a green dot when there's something you haven't read
App version now shows right away on a fresh install instead of "?"
Add exercise works like food: pick from your regular activities (most used first), search, or type a new one
Enter minutes or calories and the other is filled in from your recent rate, marked EST; type both and nothing is estimated
Plan exercise ahead: it shows with a clock and counts toward today's Left, just like planned food; tap ✓ when you've done it
Minutes and calories boxes no longer run off the edge on the phone
The ✓ on food and exercise is a grey circle while planned and turns solid green when done; tap a green one to move it back to planned
New Settings tab (⚙️) replaces the Sync button: Sync now is at the top, then meal sections, water and About. Plan keeps your calorie plan, progress, level and badges
Removed the big + from the bottom bar; add food and exercise from their sections on the Day screen
The Day tab is now Today and always jumps back to today, even after opening another day from Week
Plan chart: bigger dark numbers above the bars, always clear of the average-day line, with the average shown in the legend
Progress has a Weight / Fat mass toggle, each with its own goal, target date, pace and projection; it remembers which one you last viewed
Progress chart text is darker and a bit bigger, and the goal label moves to a clear spot so it never sits on the lines
First release: log food by meal, with a daily calorie budget and what's left
Planned vs eaten: plan food ahead with a clock, tap to confirm when you eat it, with undo
Saved meals you can add as separate items, and copy a whole day
Barcode scanning, saved servings and one-tap serving counts
Unit handling: weight and volume dropdowns, fractions, grams for unit foods
Plan tab calorie schedule: pick high days and how much more, weekly total unchanged
Progress chart of weight and fat mass with your goal, pace and date
Week view with a projection for the rest of the week
Levels, XP, streaks and badges
Tell my developer and Tell my dietitian buttons
Changes save offline and sync later; the app always loads the latest version
